claims_about_writeup.quote: `submission/contribution.md` (265 words, positions the contrast against the families measured)
claims_about_writeup.why: contribution.md is approximately 260-265 words and does position the presence contrast against several other contrast families (task contrast, imagery stance, suppression-framed stance), matching the description.

message_source_quote: The white-bear paper showed the mechanism (mid-depth band, large dose, layers above the band write the implied concept into the read cell) but reproducing it is out of scope. I reproduced it as a control: think-vs-don't-think from the `directed_modulation` family peaks at **0.686** on this fit split — confirming ≥0.5 is reachable and calibrating the dose space.
writeup_source_quote: the suppression-framed stance (think about X vs. keep X out of mind) is strong (0.69 at its optimum) but its negative arm still names X, so its direction — cosine 0.78 from ours — carries a suppression component.

differences.what: Naming and crediting of the source paper for the 'think-vs-don't-think'/suppression-framed baseline
differences.message_quote: The white-bear paper showed the mechanism (mid-depth band, large dose, layers above the band write the implied concept into the read cell) but reproducing it is out of scope. I reproduced it as a control
differences.writeup_quote: the suppression-framed stance (think about X vs. keep X out of mind) is strong (0.69 at its optimum) but its negative arm still names X, so its direction — cosine 0.78 from ours — carries a suppression component.

rationale: The write-up never names the white-bear paper or any source; it describes the think-vs-don't-think contrast only as one of several generic 'contrast families' it tested, with no attribution and no statement that it is a reproduction of prior work. The closing message explicitly names 'the white-bear paper', states it showed the underlying mechanism, says reproducing it was out of scope for the submission, and frames the 0.686-scoring baseline as a deliberate control reproduction of that paper's approach — information and framing absent from the write-up.
